mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(MAX(v.boundary),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'NONE') FROM ( SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_from AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) UNION ALL SELECT valid_to AS boundary FROM rights_revision r WHERE valid_to <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) v

SELECT h.config_id AS id,h.current_version AS version_id FROM configuration_head h JOIN model_config_revision m ON m.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND m.config_id=h.config_id AND m.model_config_revision=h.current_version AND m.project_id <=> h.project_id AND m.configuration_kind='MODEL' AND m.execution_mode=h.execution_mode WHERE h.kind='MODEL' AND h.execution_mode=#{mode} AND h.current_version IS NOT NULL AND h.config_id > #{after} AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONVERT(h.config_id USING utf8mb4))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.provider)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.model_id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(m.model_version)) > 0) ORDER BY h.config_id

SELECT r.rule_version AS id,r.rule_version AS version_id FROM rule_version r JOIN rule_definition d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.rule_version=r.rule_version WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM simulation_rule_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.rule_version=r.rule_version) AND r.rule_version > #{after} AND r.status = #{status} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rule_business_definition filter_business WHERE filter_business.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND filter_business.rule_version=r.rule_version AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(filter_business.definition_json,'$.dimension')) = #{dimension} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(filter_business.definition_json,'$.handling')) = #{handling} ) AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONVERT(r.rule_version USING utf8mb4))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(r.engine_revision)) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rule_business_definition business WHERE business.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND business.rule_version=r.rule_version AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(business.definition_json,'$.name')))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(business.definition_json,'$.condition')))) > 0))) ORDER BY r.rule_version

SELECT t.template_version AS id,t.template_version AS version_id FROM template_version t JOIN template_definition d ON d.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND d.template_version=t.template_version
t.template_version > #{after} AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONVERT(t.template_version USING utf8mb4))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(d.reason)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.content_json,'$.document_type')))) > 0)
ORDER BY t.template_version
